Finite computations are illustrative, not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: This solves the motivated open practical distinction between local coexistence stability and actual eventual cooperation level in a feedback-coupled multiplayer public-goods game: an exact strict entropy certificate excludes oscillatory coexistence and initial-state-dependent interior attractors for every reward-adjustment speed; the focus/node threshold makes transient damped oscillations predictable while global outcomes remain unchanged. It substantially extends a single source numerical phase portrait and local Jacobian analysis, not a mere restatement or arbitrary parameter slice.
